subject: CERT-In flags Crafty Falcon AI-driven attacks on Indian fintechs and lenders
text:
Source: https://indianexpress.com/article/technology/tech-news-technology/cert-in-crafty-falcon-ai-driven-hacking-campaign-fintech-10951672/ (The Indian Express). Readable with source.mjs. The advisory PDF (https://www.medianama.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/CERT-In-Advisory.pdf) is a PDF that source.mjs can't read, so don't quote it.

Readable in The Indian Express: CERT-In "on Wednesday, November 4, issued a new advisory on the escalating cyber attacks against entities in the BFSI sector and said that the "threat is active and ongoing."" The actor is designated 'Crafty Falcon'. NBFCs, digital lending platforms, payment aggregators and cryptocurrency exchanges are among those affected. The actor "used AI tools to survey targets and attack them by invoking the victim's own payment and disbursement APIs, all at machine speed", based on CSIRT-Fin's analysis of reported incidents. Entities that patched were "deliberately re-targeted" due to incomplete remediation, and the campaign was timed with the festive period. Tools named: ARTEX, PentAGI, Cairn and CyberStrikeAI. The hackers made test transactions of Rs 1 before large-value transactions.

Not readable, so leave out: the advisory number CIAD-2026-0058 and the "Critical" rating (both only in the PDF).
